cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've organized a quiet lunch for you, love. After a night on the ward, your only job is to sit down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's there a bucket beside my chair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A little drip I'm handling. Take the sofa; I'll bring the tray to whichever end you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather eat upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A proper rest, yes. I'll bring your duvet down and make the sofa how you like it. Upstairs needs a little drying before I put the bed back. You don't need another job after that shift.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 assigns rest confidently; A3 offers sofa preferences and A5 converts B bed wish into downstairs bedding while minimizing the larger leak to spare a tired partner.

heightening.evidence: A5 reveals the bed has been displaced while still calling the situation a little drying and taking all work personally.
